in_sanskrit.name: प्राणशी

in_marathi.name: Pranshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joyful, radiant, and vibrant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranshi is a beautiful Hindu name that evokes the essence of joy, happiness, and radiance. Its meaning is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prasna', which means 'to ask' or 'to inquire'. This name suggests a person who is full of curiosity and wonder, always eager to learn and explore new things. It also carries the connotation of being vibrant and radiant, like a blooming flower or a glowing ember.
